gametext: For each headquarters you command, this dilemma is cost -1. Your opponent names a skill. For each of your missions that requires that skill, randomly select a personnel to be stopped.
Randomly select two personnel. Unless those personnel have Exobiology and Cunning>11 or Strength>13, those personnel are killed.

Randomly select a personnel. Unless that personnel has an attribute<5, he or she and a second randomly selected personnel are stopped and this dilemma returns to its owner's dilemma pile. Otherwise, he or she is stopped.

Unless you have Navigation and Weapons>7 or this mission is a Nebula mission, place your ship at a Nebula mission. If you cannot, all your personnel are stopped and place this dilemma on your ship. Damage - This ship is attributes -2.

Your opponent names a skill (except Acquisition, Intelligence, Law, or Telepathy). Randomly select three personnel. Each selected personnel who has that skill is stopped. Then kill each selected unstopped [Car] personnel.
Randomly select three personnel. Each of those personnel that does not have Anthropology or Science is stopped.
Randomly select personnel until you select a Telepathy personnel or the selected personnel have any attribute>20. Each selected personnel is killed.
Add the span of this mission to this dilemma's cost. Randomly select three personnel. Each of those personnel with an attribute>6 is stopped.
Randomly select three personnel. Unless your unselected personnel have the skills on the selected personnel, the selected personnel are stopped.
Randomly select three personnel. Each of those personnel that does not have Diplomacy or Engineer is stopped.
Unless you have Engineer, Leadership, 2 Security, and Cunning>38 or Weapons>7 and you command a [HQ] mission in a different quadrant, randomly select two personnel to be killed.

Randomly select a personnel who costs 5 or more to be stopped. If you cannot, your opponent chooses a personnel to be stopped. If a personnel who costs 5 or more was stopped by this dilemma, return this dilemma to its owner's dilemma pile.

Reveal the top five cards of your deck. Unless you have 2 Diplomacy, 2 Medical, and Telepathy or the skills on the personnel revealed this way, randomly select three personnel to be stopped and discard each revealed event and interrupt.
Randomly select a personnel. Repeat this until you select a personnel with a cost equal to or greater than the first personnel that you selected. Stop each selected personnel.
Choose a Medical personnel to be stopped. Unless the personnel stopped by this dilemma has 2 Medical, this dilemma returns to its owner's dilemma pile.
Randomly select a personnel. Repeat this until you select a personnel of a different species than the first personnel that you selected. Stop each selected personnel.
Randomly select two personnel. Unless those personnel have Geology and Cunning>11 or Strength>13, those personnel are killed.
Choose an Honor personnel to be stopped. Unless the personnel stopped by this dilemma has 2 Honor, this dilemma returns to its owner's dilemma pile.

Choose a personnel who has [Cmd] and Officer or an Android or a Hologram to be stopped. If you cannot, randomly select personnel until their total cost is 4 or more. Place those personnel on the bottom of their owner's deck.
Choose a personnel who has Treachery or Integrity<4 to be stopped. If you cannot, randomly select a personnel to be killed.

Your opponent chooses a personnel. You may replace him or her with any one personnel of the same affiliation from your discard pile. Place the personnel your opponent chose on the top of his or her owner's deck.

This dilemma is cost +1. Place this dilemma on this mission (limit one per mission). If this mission is worth 30 or more points, add 10 to each printed attribute requirement<32 needed to complete this mission. When this mission is completed, place this dilemma beneath your incomplete non-headquarters mission.
Randomly select three personnel. Each of those personnel that does not have Programming or Security is stopped.

For each of your personnel who costs 2 or less attempting this mission, this dilemma is cost -1. Randomly select three personnel. Each of those personnel who has a cost of 2 or less is killed. If no personnel were killed by this dilemma, your opponent chooses one of the selected personnel to be placed in your opponent's brig.
Randomly select two personnel. Each of those personnel who does not have Treachery is killed.

If you have four or more personnel who have a cost of 2 or less attempting this mission, this dilemma is cost -3. Choose a Leadership or Security personnel to be stopped. Then choose an Engineer or Programming personnel to be stopped.
Randomly select two personnel. Each of those personnel who does not have Leadership is killed.
Randomly select three personnel. Each Officer personnel selected is stopped. Then place each unstopped [Rom] selected at your headquarters mission.
When you reveal this dilemma from the dilemma stack, if this mission is worth 35 or less points, it is cost -1. Randomly select two personnel to be stopped.
Your opponent chooses two personnel to be stopped. When this dilemma is overcome, if it was prevented, your opponent may choose one of your personnel involved in the mission attempt to be killed.
Your opponent chooses a personnel to be killed. If you do not command a completed space mission, he or she chooses an additional personnel to be killed.

For each event your opponent commands in their core, this dilemma is cost -1 (-2 for each Decay event). Unless you have 2 Engineer, 2 Medical, and Cunning>38 or 2 Diplomacy, Leadership, and 2 Physics, randomly select two personnel to be placed in your opponent's brig.
Choose a personnel who has Diplomacy or Integrity>6 to be stopped. If you cannot, randomly select a personnel to be killed.

For each event your opponent commands in his or her core, this dilemma is cost -1 (-2 for each Decay event). Unless you have 2 Leadership, Officer, Security, and Cunning>38 or 2 Engineer, Programming, and 2 Science, randomly select two personnel to be placed in your opponent's brig.

For each event your opponent commands in his or her core, this dilemma is cost -1. Unless you have 2 Anthropology, 2 Programming, and Cunning>38 or 2 Biology, Exobiology, and 2 Medical, randomly select three personnel to be killed.
Unless you have Honor or Treachery, all your personnel are stopped. If you have two or more personnel who have Honor or Treachery, randomly select all but one of those personnel to be stopped.

For each event your opponent commands in his or her core, this dilemma is cost -1. Unless you have 2 Geology, 2 Physics, and Cunning>38 or 2 Honor, 2 Officer, and Transporters, randomly select three personnel to be killed.
For each headquarters mission you command, this dilemma is cost -1. Randomly select a personnel who has a cost of 2 or less. All your other personnel who have a cost of 2 or less are stopped.
